title: 5 Nov-Diwali Celebration at Dreamz Home Orphanage

photo.alt: 5 Nov-Diwali Celebration at Dreamz Home Orphanage

summary: A wonderful Diwali Party was organised on 5th November at Dreamz Home Centre for Girls, Samajik Vikas Centre, Malad East.
description:
A wonderful Diwali Party was organised on 5th November at Dreamz Home Centre for Girls, Samajik Vikas Centre, Malad East.
It was a celebration of 19 years of love and care transforming the lives of 300+ children. It was a heart-warming afternoon with our very own Dreamz Home family and our 38 wonderful children.
Many young lives have blossomed here since 2007; some of the children are now building careers in corporates and making their own mark in the world.
The children were treated to a spectacular magic shown, snacks and t-shirts were distributed.
The joyous celebration at Dreamz Home Orphanage was attended by President Rtn Amit Gupta and Rtn PP Hussain & Yakuta Rassai.
Project cost Rs 50,000/- sponsored by Rtn PP Hussain Rassai.
